individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap overlays of cell-type fraction on tissue sections; heatmap-type visualizations do not require individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on these spatial heatmap plots.

individual-data-points.explanation: Individual sample points (dots) are overlaid on the box plots for each category and group.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile
error-bars-defined.explanation: Caption defines the box plot elements (interquartile range) and provides explicit minima, maxima, median, Q1 and Q3 values for every group/category.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the GSEA enrichment line plots.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bars show single computed log2 fold-change statistics per gene from differential expression analysis (not a mean across a small number of replicates), and no error bars are shown that would otherwise need replicate points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the fold-change bar graph; only p-values are annotated above bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.
